name: garry
note: Le gain constaté porte sur le réseau seul contre un adversaire aléatoire. Le contrôle hybride ne montre aucun gain de résultat. Les cinq autres modes ont exactement les mêmes poids effectifs.

position_training.architecture_change: Added compact 32-feature position-value branch; existing policy matrices unchanged

source_metrics.target: depth-9 bounded search centipoints, non-mate positions
source_metrics.split: whole game trajectories; validation not used for fitting or hyperparameters

duels.baseline: frozen Garry 2.0.0 WASM; identical policy weights
duels.note: Fixed node budgets, independent seeded paired openings, 10s safety only. No excluded defeats.

position_training.extended_experiment: 1600 trajectories, 9963 train and 2527 validation positions; not selected; more training did not improve the selection matches

notes: Position scores measure policy-only choices against exact or bounded teachers, not whole-game wins.
C4 sound choices are within 24 points of the bounded best without sacrificing a proved result.
League results unchanged: C4 candidate did not pass its position gates and C4 weights stayed frozen.
2048 candidate improved short rollouts but was rejected after full games; original 2048 weights were restored.
These small controls do not establish statistically significant whole-game superiority.

certified_search.scope: Duels depuis le plateau vide contre la version précédente 3.1.0, dans les deux camps, réglages niveau 10 originaux.
